sources.title: Amazon EC2 On-Demand Pricing

sources.title: What is Amazon EKS?

investigation.content: Across the four sources read, every vendor prices compute by region, size and purchase option, so no vendor can be ranked on price without a normalized live quote [aws-ec2-pricing] [azure-vm-pricing] [gcp-compute-pricing]. GKE's Autopilot and Standard modes change the billing basis itself, which a comparison must hold constant [gcp-gke-overview].

sources.title: Amazon EC2 On-Demand Pricing
sources.excerpt: EC2 On-Demand capacity is billed without a long-term commitment; operating system, region, storage, networking, and other attached services can change the total workload cost.

sources.title: What is Amazon EKS?
sources.excerpt: Amazon EKS manages the Kubernetes control plane and offers standard and more automated operating modes; worker compute and supporting AWS resources remain separately relevant to cost and operations.

sources.excerpt: Amazon EKS manages the Kubernetes control plane and offers standard and more automated operating modes; worker compute and supporting AWS resources remain separately relevant to cost and operations.

sources.excerpt: AKS is a managed Kubernetes service with Azure-managed control-plane components and VM-backed nodes, with Automatic and Standard modes offering different balances of defaults and operator control.

sources.title: Linux Virtual Machines pricing

sources.title: Compute Engine virtual machines pricing

sources.title: Google Kubernetes Engine overview
sources.excerpt: GKE provides managed Kubernetes with Standard and Autopilot modes; the modes differ in infrastructure control, node management, scaling defaults, and which resources form the billing basis.

investigation.content: Across the four sources read, every vendor prices compute by region, size and purchase option, so no vendor can be ranked on price without a normalized live quote [aws-ec2-pricing] [azure-vm-pricing] [gcp-compute-pricing].
